headline: Lightweight serum, no sticky residue
subhead: Apply 2-3 drops after cleansing & toning; let it absorb fully before the next step.
proof_points: Niacinamide, Matmarine, Zinc and Acetyl Glucosamine
footnote: 4 out of 5 stars from 1,491 reviews on beminimalist.co, captured 2026-10-02
layout_description: Left column: large strength figure and active name, then headline, subhead and up to three proof points; the AI-generated person scene (person_prompt) is the human cue and carries the AI-GENERATED — ILLUSTRATIVE mark top-right; real pack shot composited in the right 45%; rating line in the footnote band, CTA bottom-left.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a pale grey-green matte tiled wall above a narrow stone counter edge, soft daylight from the upper left, minimal and uncluttered. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the right 45% of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit, reserved for a pack photo placed later, and keep the left 50% calm and low-detail, reserved for copy added later. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Angle: sensorial, from the page's texture and usage facts only: 'lightweight serum ... no sticky residue' (F8, quoted without the sebum and inflammation wording) and 'let the serum absorb fully' (F13). Kept: close hand-level application framing (Chemist at Play), finger-on-skin moment as the visual cue (Foxtale). Dropped: timed-fix headline, '#1 daily duo' device, pore, sebum and melanin outcomes, 'highly effective' superlative in F5. The person is AI-generated (High risk, labelled); a real application photo would lower the risk. Rating in the footnote slot.

blend_sources.took: close hand-level framing of the application moment
finger-on-skin application moment as the visual cue

person_prompt: Macro-style close-up of a man in his early 30s with a light-brown skin tone and short stubble, shown from the nose to the jaw in a bright bathroom in the morning; two fingertips are pressing a few clear, lightweight drops into his cheek and spreading them downward with a light touch while his other hand is out of frame; soft daylight from the upper left, plain pale grey-green tile behind, shallow depth of field, relaxed expression, natural skin texture with visible pores, no retouching, nothing implying a result. No product, bottle, dropper, tube, jar or packaging anywhere in frame; no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names.

verdict.label: Ready for human review
verdict.detail: No blocking or must-fix issues found. This is a pre-screen, not an approval: brand and legal sign-off is still required.
